doc.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]

title: Thelonious Monk and 'Round Midnight
summary: Budd calls Monk insane yet loves 'Round Midnight, which he learned to play; talk of its key.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: And people like Thelonious Monk, I think he must be insane and yet there’s one tune I know he plays that I think is just a gorgeous thing called “‘Round Midnight.” You’ve heard of that?

I think it’s very pretty. I’ve learned to play that by hearing him and another piano player wrote down lead line for it and it’s a gorgeous thing. And yet some other people have told me are the ones, “Ruby” is one I wouldn’t know it if I heard it. But this “‘Round Midnight” is a hit with me.
Beautiful. And tough, a tough tune too.
